response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems software engineer with nearly two decades of experience, but the role requires a Director-level Principal Engineer with deep, recognized AI expertise, strategic customer advisory experience, and demonstrated AI product/platform leadership at scale. His experience is almost entirely general web/backend/embedded development with only very recent, surface-level exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators), no advanced AI/ML degree, no strategic/advisory positioning, and no evidence of influencing cloud/AI strategy at an organizational or industry level.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive via founding and maintaining an open-source platform (GISCollective) for years
Strong software craftsmanship background with testing, CI/CD, and knowledge-sharing (talks, workshops, courses)
concerns: Minimal and only very recent AI-specific experience (a few months on MCP tooling), far short of 'recognized AI expertise'
No advanced degree in AI-related field and no track record of building or shipping AI products/platforms
No evidence of strategic customer/partner advisory work or influencing cloud/AI technology direction at a director/principal strategic level

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise and AI product track record
No strategic advisory or cloud/AI strategy leadership experience
Extensive general engineering experience and craftsmanship
